id: \bFeeling stuck? Talk to the Trainers. They will take you across the platforms.
en: \bFeeling stuck? Talk to the Trainers. They will take you across the platforms.
it: \bTi sei bloccato? Parla con gli Allenatori. Ti porteranno da una piattaforma all'altra.

id: \bI'm the last one before the Gym Leader.
en: \bI'm the last one before the Gym Leader.

id: \bCrasher Wake uses Water type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Grass and Electric types.
en: \bCrasher Wake uses Water type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Grass and Electric types.
it: \bOmar usa Pokémon di tipo Acqua. Sono deboli contro i tipi Erba ed Elettro.

id: \bThey are strong against Fire, Ground, and Rock. Fire, Ice, Steel, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Fire, Ground, and Rock.  Fire, Ice, Steel, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Fuoco, Terra e Roccia.  Anche le mosse di tipo Fuoco, Ghiaccio, Acciaio e Acqua non fanno molti danni.

id: \bCrasher Wake: Welcome! I've been looking forward to a good battle!
en: \bCrasher Wake: Welcome! I've been looking forward to a good battle!
it: \bOmar: Benvenuto! Non vedevo l'ora di fare una bella lotta!

id: \bMy Pokémon were toughened up by stormy white waters! They'll take everything you can throw at them and then pull you under!
en: \bMy Pokémon were toughened up by stormy white waters! They'll take everything you can throw at them and then pull you under!
it: \bI miei Pokémon si sono temprati tra le rapide in tempesta! Incasseranno tutto quello che puoi lanciargli e poi ti trascineranno a fondo!

id: \bCrasher Wake: You've earned the Fen Badge.
en: \bCrasher Wake: You've earned the Fen Badge.
it: \bOmar: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Palude.

id: \bTM97 contains Aqua Jet. It always lets you attack first.
en: \bTM97 contains Aqua Jet. It always lets you attack first.
it: \bLa MT97 contiene Acquagetto. Ti permette sempre di attaccare per primo.

id: \bCrasher Wake: I'm always training under the rains of the Great Marsh. Check it out sometime. You would like it.
en: \bCrasher Wake: I'm always training under the rains of the Great Marsh. Check it out sometime. You would like it.
it: \bOmar: Mi alleno sempre sotto la pioggia della Gran Palude. Vacci a dare un'occhiata, prima o poi. Ti piacerebbe.
